title: App Store reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one customer review, charged), app (context for an app on a storefront, free) and status (per app and country, free).

dataset.title: App Store reviews
dataset.description: One row per customer review, plus per-app rows and per-app-and-country status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; app and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its filtered/duplicate/error tallies, and its HTTP stats.
